description: Start Auto Review of a public page in a readable project. Uses your scan allowance and the project’s review settings, ignored findings and already-filed issues. Returns a persistent job ID; results include findings, scores, AI status and screenshot evidence. Does not create issues. Login-required pages need the browser extension.

breakpointLabel.description: Optional label, such as Desktop or Mobile

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

requestId.description: New UUID for this review; reuse after a lost response

name: run_auto_review
